atomic_facts.fact: The exact legal name of FTX is FTX Trading Ltd.
FTX Trading Ltd was incorporated in Antigua and Barbuda.
FTX Trading Ltd is headquartered in The Bahamas.
FTX filed a Chapter 11 petition on November 11, 2022.
As of 2026-10-01, FTX is still undergoing bankruptcy proceedings.
The CFTC filed an enforcement complaint against FTX (with Bankman-Fried and Alameda) charging fraud.
The SEC brought an enforcement action charging FTX with wrongdoing.
These CFTC and SEC enforcement actions against FTX had been brought before 2026-10-01.
As of 2026-10-01, FTX has not been convicted of a criminal offense.
Only regulatory charges have been filed against FTX (i.e., no criminal charges exist against the company).
The CFTC and SEC have charged FTX and its founders for wrongdoing.
